_comment: Generated by visuals/tools/build-descriptors.py from visuals/data/ai.json (hand-curated from each crate's README) and descriptors.json. golem.fm's patch AI reads it with descriptors.json to choose blocks and presets; copy it with the sync tool at a commit. Do not edit.

gfx-boost.name: GoleM FX Boost
gfx-boost.purpose: Transparent gain utility: volume pedal with true silence at the heel, clean level boost, scene level-matching and a polarity flip.
gfx-boost.position_note: before the amp to push it; after the amp for a solo boost; before delay/reverb for swells

pairs_well_with.why: use gfx-drive when the boost should add colour; this one stays clean
+6 to +12 dB in front of an amp pushes it harder
volume swells on EXP placed before delay / reverb

gfx-gate.name: GoleM FX Gate
gfx-gate.purpose: Zero-latency noise gate / expander with hysteresis, follow-decay release, tail damp, hum-aware detection and an optional key input from the DI.
gfx-gate.position_note: before a high-gain amp, or after it keyed from the clean DI (source Key)

pairs_well_with.why: metal: gate before the amp, or after it keyed from the DI so the threshold ignores gain
the drive has no built-in gate on purpose: this gate keyed on the DI does it better

gfx-comp.name: GoleM FX Comp
gfx-comp.purpose: Zero-latency compressor with five characters (clean, bus, FET, opto, pedal) on one static curve, sidechain low cut, range and parallel mix.
gfx-comp.position_note: before drive/amp for sustain; Bus character after amp and cab for glue

pairs_well_with.why: opto/FET before the amp for lead sustain or peak control
Bus character after amp and cab glues the tone
the de-esser's relative detection holds with a compressor upstream
Voice profile chorus is suggested after compression on the vocal lane

gfx-comp.cpu_note: status line: ~0.1 µs / sample; colour stage runs 2x oversampled only when character or drive needs it

gfx-limiter.name: GoleM FX Limiter
gfx-limiter.purpose: Peak limiter whose threshold is the output ceiling: zero latency by default with a band-limited clipper, optional lookahead with true peak.
gfx-limiter.position_note: last block of the lane; threshold = the peak you get, no makeup

pairs_well_with.why: Clean or Punchy after an amp: louder lead without clipping the PA
lookahead 2 ms + true peak: fully transparent on backing tracks / keys

gfx-eq.name: GoleM FX EQ
gfx-eq.purpose: Zero-latency live EQ: analog-matched low/high cut, shelves, two proportional-Q bells, air, tilt, a dynamic de-harsh band and static auto gain.
gfx-eq.position_note: after amp and cab for guitar (90 Hz low cut, 7 kHz high cut at 24 dB/oct)

pairs_well_with.why: 24 dB/oct high cut after a cab simulation; the two cuts every mixed guitar gets
de-harsh tames high-gain fizz only when it is there

gfx-deesser.name: GoleM FX De-esser
gfx-deesser.purpose: Zero-latency de-esser with level-independent detection and shelf/bell/wide reduction; also a high-frequency de-harsh for overdriven guitar.
gfx-deesser.position_note: voice: gate, de-esser, pitch correction, comp (golem's voice order); before gfx-formant

pairs_well_with.why: relative detection keeps working with a compressor upstream
Allround / Bell at 3.5 kHz removes pick click and fizz from overdriven guitar

gfx-wah.name: GoleM FX Wah
gfx-wah.purpose: Pedal wah with eleven measured voices, per-pedal taper, smooth EXP response, resonance clipping, auto-engage and envelope / LFO modes.
gfx-wah.position_note: before the amp (into high gain: q 80 %, volume +3 dB)

pairs_well_with.why: wah before a high-gain amp, with a little boost, clips at the resonance
sibling: same follower and wah voice when no pedal is used

gfx-autowah.name: GoleM FX Autowah
gfx-autowah.purpose: Envelope filter at any input level: low/band/high-pass, wah and vowel types, 2 or 4 poles, saturated filter, dry lows for bass, LFO or S&H sweeps.

pairs_well_with.why: the Wah type reuses its voice; use gfx-wah when a pedal drives the sweep

gfx-tremolo.name: GoleM FX Tremolo
gfx-tremolo.purpose: Amp-style tremolo: clean, bias, optical, neon and harmonic models, synced or free, click-free square, playing-dependent depth, auto-pan.

pairs_well_with.why: hard gates, step patterns and pick triggers live there, not here

gfx-vibrato.name: GoleM FX Vibrato
gfx-vibrato.purpose: Pitch vibrato with depth in cents constant at any speed: clean, bucket-brigade, varistor (zero latency), rotary-style and organ scanner voices.

pairs_well_with.why: the Vibe model shares the phaser's Vibe core

gfx-chorus.name: GoleM FX Chorus
gfx-chorus.purpose: Instrument-voiced chorus: classic pedal, dual synth, dimension, ensemble and doubler modes on clean, bucket-brigade or tape engines, mono-safe.
gfx-chorus.position_note: after amp and cab; never before a high-gain stage

pairs_well_with.why: after amp and cab: stereo from there on, BBD hiss not amplified
Drive wide preset after a high-gain amp: wide, chugs stay clear
Voice profile: on the vocal lane after compression

avoid.why: a chorus before distortion turns into mush; place it after

gfx-flanger.name: GoleM FX Flanger
gfx-flanger.purpose: Flanger with bucket-brigade, tape through-zero, pseudo through-zero and barberpole modes; LFO, envelope or pedal sweep; safe high feedback.

pairs_well_with.why: shares the BBD engine; reach for the chorus for thickening, this for combs

gfx-phaser.name: GoleM FX Phaser
gfx-phaser.purpose: Exact zero-latency phaser: script/block 4-stage, OTA, rotary-style vibe, dual-phaser, deep 12-stage and barberpole voices, LFO/envelope/pedal sweep.

pairs_well_with.why: Vibe model before the amp: unequal stages, lamp lag, throb
same Vibe core; vibe_mode Vibrato covers the pitch side

gfx-rotary.name: GoleM FX Rotary
gfx-rotary.purpose: Rotating-speaker simulator: horn and drum with their own inertia, Doppler and directivity, cabinets, mics, tube drive and a coasting brake.
gfx-rotary.position_note: mono in / stereo out; keys: after the instrument

pairs_well_with.why: keys: the slow / fast transition on electric piano

avoid.why: golem's organ keeps its own rotating speaker; do not add a second one

gfx-rotary.cpu_note: 375 ns / sample at 48 kHz, mono in / stereo out (1.8 % of a core)

gfx-drive.name: GoleM FX Drive
gfx-drive.purpose: Parametric overdrive / distortion / fuzz engine, alias-free at high gain, with tight, tone, sag, asymmetry, clean blend and bass keep.
gfx-drive.position_note: in front of the amp; as a tight low-gain boost before a high-gain amp

pairs_well_with.why: Overdrive, low gain, tight 200 Hz tightens a high-gain amp
no built-in gate: the gate keyed on the DI does it better
NAM captures cover exact pedals; this covers the parametric families

gfx-delay.name: GoleM FX Delay
gfx-delay.purpose: Live delay with digital, tape, bucket-brigade and lo-fi engines; ducking, swell, reverse, pitched repeats, multi-tap, hold and trails.
gfx-delay.position_note: end of the lane; kill_dry + mix 100 % for a parallel wet lane

pairs_well_with.why: repeats into a tail for ambient washes

gfx-reverb.name: GoleM FX Reverb
gfx-reverb.purpose: Algorithmic reverb (hall, plate, room, chamber, cathedral, ambience, spring, bloom, cloud, gated, reverse) with freeze, ducking and trails.
gfx-reverb.position_note: end of the lane; Spring and Ambience can also sit right after a dry amp sim

pairs_well_with.why: Room / Ambience early reflections give a dry amp sim air
use it when the shimmer is the subject (two voices, placement, glide)

gfx-reverb.cpu_note: 525 ns / sample at 48 kHz (2.5 % of a core, likely the default stereo layout); 70s era 28-35 % cheaper

gfx-shimmer.name: GoleM FX Shimmer
gfx-shimmer.purpose: Shimmer reverb: pitch shifters inside the reverb loop (two voices, ±24 st) for rising octave pads, with freeze, bloom, ducking and glide.
gfx-shimmer.position_note: end of the lane, as a reverb

pairs_well_with.why: volume-pedal swells into a long shimmer pad
gfx-reverb carries a one-voice shimmer when only a colour is wanted

gfx-shimmer.cpu_note: 707 ns / sample at 48 kHz (3.4 % of a core), tank + 2 voices, likely stereo

gfx-killswitch.name: GoleM FX Killswitch
gfx-killswitch.purpose: Rhythmic kill switch, stutter and trance gate locked to the song or restarted by the pick; also synced tremolo shapes and autopan. Zero latency.
gfx-killswitch.position_note: after drive / amp so cuts stay hard, before delay / reverb so tails survive the cuts

pairs_well_with.why: for amp-style tremolo the README points to gfx-tremolo; killswitch does gates and stutters

gfx-octaver.name: GoleM FX Octaver
gfx-octaver.purpose: Zero-latency octaver: vintage analog-style sub, clean sine sub for bass, synth sub, octave up and a polyphonic mode.
gfx-octaver.position_note: early in the lane; octave-up goes before a fuzz

pairs_well_with.why: octave-up before a fuzz gives the classic rectifier-octave lead
for arbitrary intervals or harmonies, gfx-pitch instead

gfx-pitch.name: GoleM FX Pitch
gfx-pitch.purpose: Instrument pitch shifter: expression-pedal pitch dives, fixed or in-key harmonies, two voices, and polyphonic transposition (virtual capo, 12-string).
gfx-pitch.position_note: before the amp for pitch dives / harmony into drive; for a vocal octave double use gfx-golem

pairs_well_with.why: for a synth-like sub use the octaver; pitch for intervals

gfx-pitch.cpu_note: bench, 48 kHz mono: 0.64 µs/sample at defaults; Poly engine 0.15-0.79 µs depending on the input

gfx-pitch-classic.name: GoleM FX Pitch Classic
gfx-pitch-classic.purpose: Simple two-head delay-line pitch shifter with literal window / overlap controls and independent wet / dry, zero reported latency.

pairs_well_with.why: for clean chords or low-glitch tracking, the modern shifter

gfx-detune.name: GoleM FX Detune
gfx-detune.purpose: Micro-pitch detune / doubler: one or two voices a few cents off with an optional doubling delay, for width and thickening at zero latency.
gfx-detune.position_note: after the amp for stereo widening; before delay / reverb

pairs_well_with.why: for larger intervals or harmonies

gfx-met.name: GoleM FX Met
gfx-met.purpose: Keyed expander-gate for high gain: listens to the clean DI, silences the gaps between chugs with no audible gating, one threshold knob.
gfx-met.position_note: front of a high-gain lane: met -> shem / emet -> amp; key from the lane DI

pairs_well_with.why: built and tested in front of / keyed around a NAM high-gain amp
high-gain companion: tight boost into the amp
high-gain companion: mid-push overdrive into the amp

gfx-emet.name: GoleM FX Emet
gfx-emet.purpose: High-headroom mid-hump overdrive: clean mid boost at low gain, a crushing mid push in front of a high-gain amp; also a classic low-headroom diode knee.
gfx-emet.position_note: right before a high-gain amp, after met

pairs_well_with.why: tightens a high-gain amp: the amp clips, not the pedal
high-gain front: gate first, then the boost into the amp

gfx-shem.name: GoleM FX Shem
gfx-shem.purpose: Clean frequency-shaped tight boost (up to +20 dB, no clipping): cuts bass mud and lifts presence so a high-gain amp stays defined.
gfx-shem.position_note: directly in front of an amp that already has gain; lower the amp's gain

pairs_well_with.why: all the grind is the amp's; shem decides what reaches it
high-gain front: met -> shem -> amp

gfx-golem.name: GoleM FX Golem
gfx-golem.purpose: Live vocal doubler: one or two pitch-shifted copies of the singer (an octave-below double first), formants kept or moved, dry never delayed.
gfx-golem.position_note: voice lane: after deesser and any gate, before delay / reverb

pairs_well_with.why: placed before gfx-golem on a voice lane
placed before it; also set thresh above stage bleed

gfx-glitch.name: GoleM FX Glitch
gfx-glitch.purpose: Spectral (STFT) pedal: sustains partials into pads, blurs into clouds, shifts, crushes, scatters or stutters the spectrum; dry never delayed.
gfx-glitch.position_note: near the end of the lane, before or beside reverb; wet is late by size + hop

pairs_well_with.why: glitch is not a reverb; reverb after it smooths the pads

gfx-glitch.cpu_note: 169 ns mono at defaults (317 ns stereo frame); everything on ≈ 3.3 % of a core (~0.7 µs)

gfx-geq.name: GoleM FX Graphic EQ
gfx-geq.purpose: Graphic EQ whose response is exactly the curve the faders draw: 11-band octave or 7-band guitar/bass pedal layouts, low/high cuts, solo level.
gfx-geq.position_note: post-amp or post-cab tone shaping; also before a high-gain amp to tighten, or as a solo-lift stage

pairs_well_with.why: Low faders cut before a high-gain amp tighten the front end without a peak at 125 Hz
Post-cab cleanup: low cut, 24 dB/oct high cut and a fader where the cab is harsh
Guitar 7 mid push restores the mids a fuzz scoops out in a band mix
Bass 7 layout for slap smile or growl after the bass preamp

gfx-geq.cpu_note: Busy Octave 11 curve; 0.27 µs while a fader moves; flat 0.019 µs; solver tick 8 µs per 1.33 ms only while moving

gfx-freqshift.name: GoleM FX Freqshift
gfx-freqshift.purpose: Single-sideband frequency shifter with feedback loop, LFO and envelope: endless barber-pole phasing, metallic detune, bells, spiralling echoes.
gfx-freqshift.position_note: stereo by nature (2/2): placed before an amp it turns the whole lane stereo; use gfx-ringmod for clang before the amp

pairs_well_with.why: Mono-first ring modulator: the pedal for inharmonic clang before the amp
Shifted echoes longer than 2 s are gfx-delay with its loop_shift

avoid.why: Before an amp the 2/2 block turns the lane stereo, so every later block runs (and costs) stereo

gfx-freqshift.cpu_note: 136 ns per stereo frame with a mono source; ~0.23 µs true stereo, ~0.34 µs with loop Phaser and dry_match on

gfx-swell.name: GoleM FX Swell
gfx-swell.purpose: Zero-latency auto-swell: each pick, legato change or new chord fades in on its own for bowed, violin-like attacks; one swell per strum.
gfx-swell.position_note: after drive/amp with source Key (clean DI), before delay and reverb; or first in the chain with curve dB

pairs_well_with.why: A compressor before the swell lengthens the bowed note (raise thresh: it lifts hiss)
Cello pad and ambient presets swell into a long reverb after the block
Tempo swells: synced rise, then a dotted-quarter delay and a long reverb
Sits after drive/amp with source Key reading the clean DI, so detection is not flattened

gfx-swell.cpu_note: 0.14-0.165 µs with every detector on; 0.059 µs with legato 0

gfx-crusher.name: GoleM FX Crusher
gfx-crusher.purpose: Bitcrusher and sample-rate reducer simulating a virtual ADC/DAC exactly: band-limited aliasing, gliding clock, µ-law/float words, clean tails.
gfx-crusher.position_note: a dirt effect; its Clean tails setting is designed for a gain stage after it

pairs_well_with.why: tails Clean fades sub-LSB sputter that a gain stage after the block would turn into fizz

gfx-crusher.cpu_note: Defaults; 0.277 µs worst case (Clean model + track + LFO + jitter); 0.113 µs per stereo frame

gfx-ringmod.name: GoleM FX Ringmod
gfx-ringmod.purpose: Ring modulator with a free oscillator carrier (bells, robot voice, tremolo into clangour) or a phase-locked carrier that follows the played note.
gfx-ringmod.position_note: Track carrier needs a clean single-note input; set bass_keep on bass

pairs_well_with.why: a ring-mod pedal sound feeding the amp, like the classic ring-mod solo use

gfx-ringmod.cpu_note: Free/Clean 121 ns; Track + lock 263 ns; Track + Diode + LFO + bass_keep 422 ns (over 300 ns budget)

gfx-bassdi.name: GoleM FX Bass DI
gfx-bassdi.purpose: Bass preamp/DI: compressor before the dirt, clean and driven paths blended in phase, tuning-aware low corners, 4-band EQ, switchable speaker emulation.
gfx-bassdi.position_note: it is the bass amp/DI stage; set cab Off when an amp, a cab or an IR follows

pairs_well_with.why: With cab Off, golem's cab block / IR does the speaker instead of the built-in emulation
Into an IR: switch the built-in speaker emulation Off

avoid.why: One block replaces a two-branch bi-amp chain; a parallel branch outside it is not phase-coherent
Before an amp, golem writes cab Off; leaving the cab on doubles the speaker colour

gfx-bassdi.cpu_note: 0.92-1.03 µs mono at defaults (8x oversampling); ~1.64 µs during a model crossfade

gfx-tape.name: GoleM FX Tape
gfx-tape.purpose: Tape and lo-fi media machine: hysteresis saturation, wow and flutter, dropouts, hiss and tape stop for reel, cassette, VHS, vinyl and 78 colour.
gfx-tape.position_note: media colour after the amp/cab, before delay and reverb; also usable before an amp as soft tape drive

pairs_well_with.why: chained for a 'sampled from a tape' lo-fi sound (both in the lofi category)
tape here is the machine in series with no repeats; echoes come from the delay

avoid.why: hiss or 78/vinyl surface noise before a high-gain amp gets magnified; keep noise in Follow or off

gfx-tape.cpu_note: 1.0 µs mono at defaults (bench line 1.4 on a loaded machine), 1.6 µs worst; real stereo input ≈ 2× mono

gfx-grit.name: GoleM FX Grit
gfx-grit.purpose: Four-band multiband distortion: two antialiased dirt modules per band, level-matched, with Drive/Focus macros. Lo-fi crunch, band-split bass drive.
gfx-grit.position_note: voice: after de-esser, before comp; drums/loops: after amp or cab; guitar: before a clean amp

pairs_well_with.why: On voice, sits after the de-esser (catalogue order note)
On voice, goes before the compressor (catalogue order note)
Guitar: before the amp when the amp is clean; Chord Clarity keeps chords readable
Drums and loops: placed after the amp or a cab

gfx-grit.cpu_note: defaults 236 ns mono; Quality on 392 ns; worst (8 saturators, LR8, 4x) 1.36 us; stereo ~306 ns/frame

gfx-dist.name: GoleM FX Dist
gfx-dist.purpose: Circuit-simulated distortion pedals (op-amp dist, booster dist, clean-blend OD, MOSFET OD) solved as real circuits; swappable diodes and op-amps.
gfx-dist.position_note: before the amp (clean or pushed); first-stage pushes can stack into a second instance

pairs_well_with.why: Low-gain crunch into a clean amp, transparent push into a pushed amp (Applications)
Same into an amp capture; unlike pedal-nam it has every pot position and responds to guitar volume

gfx-dist.cpu_note: per circuit 3.1-4.1 us; 6.8 us on a loaded machine; a circuit switch doubles it for 30 ms; L!=R stereo doubles

gfx-transient.name: GoleM FX Transient
gfx-transient.purpose: Threshold-free transient shaper: boosts or cuts attacks and sustain in dB, the same at any playing level, for picks, bass, drums and voice.
gfx-transient.position_note: before the amp/drive; after the amp only with source Key reading the clean DI

pairs_well_with.why: placed before the amp: an attack boost hits it harder, an attack cut smooths the pick into it
put it before gfx-comp to keep attacks a compressor would dull
Consonants preset on voice: diction lift, with the de-esser after
Chug Tight complements a gate on palm-muted metal rhythm

avoid.why: after gfx-swell is pointless: it already removed the attacks

gfx-transient.cpu_note: ≈ 80 ns shaping; 150 ns with ceiling Limit; 180 – 260 ns with Soft

gfx-mbcomp.name: GoleM FX MB Comp
gfx-mbcomp.purpose: 3- or 4-band compressor with upward lift/expansion per band, a phase that never moves with gain, noise guard, Amount/Tilt face and auto gain.
gfx-mbcomp.position_note: after amp and cab on guitar; on voice after the de-esser; before a limiter when pushed

pairs_well_with.why: keep the de-esser before gfx-mbcomp on a voice: it does the 's', mbcomp the regions
put a limiter after gfx-mbcomp when the Hyper (OTT-style) setting is pushed
after the bass preamp's compressor, mbcomp handles string-to-string balance
Tight chug: after amp and cab, holds palm-mute boom while the top stays open

gfx-widener.name: GoleM FX Widener
gfx-widener.purpose: Stereo widener and imager: turns a mono lane into a wide image (or narrows, mono-izes the lows, places a stereo source) with an exact mono fold.
gfx-widener.position_note: after the last mono block (amp, mono cab), before stereo delay / reverb

pairs_well_with.why: goes right after the amp / cab: the last mono block must come before the widener
stereo delay after the widener sees a wide source; before it, the widener would widen the dry centre
reverb after it sees a wide source; the widener adds width without a room
a linked limiter downstream keeps the exact mono fold all the way to the PA

avoid.why: a mono amp (or any mono block) after the widener sums the width back to the dry
overlap: use the chorus for moving thickening, the widener for static mono-safe width

gfx-widener.cpu_note: 62 ns per stereo frame at default (Velvet); Double mode ≈ 150 ns per stereo frame

gfx-ducker.name: GoleM FX Ducker
gfx-ducker.purpose: Ducker: lowers a signal while a key plays (Follow), on key onsets (Trigger) or on the beat (Pump), full band or Bell/Low/High/Spectral.
gfx-ducker.position_note: tail duck: after the effect on a wet-only branch; Pump: anywhere on pads/keys/clean chords

pairs_well_with.why: Self-ducks a looper's playback under live playing on a wet-only branch, keyed by the lane DI
Tail duck for effects with no ducking of their own (granular, glitch, captures, third-party)
Tail duck on a wet-only branch after the glitch, keyed by the lane DI
Singer or soloist ducks the backing (Spectral, stereo Mid) once service-bus slots exist

gfx-ducker.cpu_note: Wide 38 ns, Bell 39-50 ns, Spectral 157-168 ns mono (174-187 stereo)

gfx-fuzz.name: GoleM FX Fuzz
gfx-fuzz.purpose: Transistor fuzz circuits simulated with the guitar's pickup and volume knob in front: real cleanup, bias, temperature and battery sag.
gfx-fuzz.position_note: first after the input, on the raw DI; before the amp

pairs_well_with.why: Accepted CPU for a pedal used once per lane in front of an amp model
Fuzz goes in front of the amp; guitar_vol on EXP gives the clean channel

gfx-fuzz.cpu_note: Ge Pair 4.4 us, Si Four ~4.9 us; buffer on 5.3-5.7 us; 7.9 us loaded machine; model switch doubles for 30 ms

gfx-tuner.name: GoleM FX Tuner
gfx-tuner.purpose: Strobe-precision tuner with string-aware and strum (polyphonic) readings; bit-exact pass-through or muted while tuning, zero latency.
gfx-tuner.position_note: one instance first in each instrument lane, inserted bypassed
gfx-tuner.cpu_note: 30 ns engaged; 94 ns with eight poly tracks; 1.4 ns bypassed

gfx-cab.name: GoleM FX Cab
gfx-cab.purpose: Zero-latency cabinet IR loader: one or two IRs blended with auto-align and polarity, cuts, bass keep and parallel DI; click-free IR swaps.
gfx-cab.position_note: after the amp or amp capture (amp-nam / preamp-nam / amp), before EQ, modulation and time effects

pairs_well_with.why: Supplies the speaker for an amp capture without a cab; zero latency, level-matched IRs
Bass: bassdi then gfx-cab with bass_keep ~120 Hz; set bassdi's own cab Off
Its cuts are the cab's own; a full EQ goes after it
Acoustic body IR under the piezo with a parallel dry (Acoustic body preset)

gfx-cab.cpu_note: 200 ms cab 0.42% core; with IR B 0.79%; 2 s cab 0.80%; bench built-in 76 ns; block peaks 3.7-4.7x mean

gfx-irfx.name: GoleM FX IR FX
gfx-irfx.purpose: Stereo convolution effect for captured springs, echoes and reverb boxes: one IR up to 20 s, predelay, reverse, trim, width, trails, zero latency.
gfx-irfx.position_note: end of the lane on a stereo lane

pairs_well_with.why: same engine; cab handles the speaker, IR FX the captured spring or echo

gfx-irfx.cpu_note: 4 s IR stereo 1.0-1.7 % of a core (≈0.2-0.35 µs per frame); 20 s 1.7 %; 40 ns with no IR

gfx-correct.name: GoleM FX Correct
gfx-correct.purpose: Pitch correction for voice and mono instruments: snaps to key/scale while keeping or reshaping vibrato; low-latency live engine or formant-exact studio engine.
gfx-correct.position_note: voice lane: after the de-esser, before the compressor (golem's voice order)

pairs_well_with.why: golem's voice order puts the de-esser just before pitch correction
The compressor follows pitch correction in golem's voice order
Shares the psola engine; its spectral envelope restores formants for larger Live shifts (staged)

gfx-correct.cpu_note: Live mono; 0.064 µs stereo; Studio renders cost about the same

gfx-vocoder.name: GoleM FX Vocoder
gfx-vocoder.purpose: Zero-latency channel vocoder: a voice or guitar shapes a carrier (its own pitch-tracking or song-key oscillators, noise, or itself); intelligible by design.
gfx-vocoder.position_note: Talk Box on a guitar lane goes before the amp; on voice it needs no amp

pairs_well_with.why: Talk Box on the guitar lane before the amp: the guitar speaks, the amp after it
Same Talk Box placement before an amp capture

gfx-vocoder.cpu_note: bench 594 ns mono; sung vowel 487 ns; Drone w/o noise bank 451 ns; 40 bands Supersaw stereo 1.13 us

gfx-acoustic.name: GoleM FX Acoustic
gfx-acoustic.purpose: Turns an electric guitar DI (or an acoustic-electric's piezo) into a miked acoustic guitar: measured bodies, string decay, mic position, 12-string.
gfx-acoustic.position_note: Takes the amp slot (category amp) on a clean DI; no cab after it; reverb and delay after.

pairs_well_with.why: Its room is only the air around the mic; real space comes from a reverb block after it
An acoustic amp after it is a stated real use, left without warning

avoid.why: It already models body and mic; golem-rack warns on a cab after it (stacked cab)

gfx-acoustic.cpu_note: 255-277 ns mono at defaults; + twelve 0.15-0.25 µs, + room 0.08 µs; worst 1.27 µs per stereo frame

gfx-radio.name: GoleM FX Radio
gfx-radio.purpose: Small-speaker and transmission simulator (telephone, cell call, megaphone, walkie, AM radio, PA horn, intercom, pocket radio, gramophone, laptop).
gfx-radio.position_note: Voice: the lane's distortion box, before delay/reverb. Guitar: an intro or breakdown device, full mix 100%.

pairs_well_with.why: Shellac 78 before the Gramophone model (noise 0 here): record noise there, horn here
Set speaker None and put a device IR in a cab after it for a specific phone or radio
They chain: morph for the scream, radio for the through-a-walkie device
Both lofi: grit seasons a band, radio is the whole device; voice lanes get both

gfx-radio.cpu_note: Telephone default 568 ns; Pocket Radio 335, AM 860, PA Horn + AM 963 ns; ≈1.55 µs for 40 ms during a chain+room switch

gfx-stretch.name: GoleM FX Stretch
gfx-stretch.purpose: Extreme spectral time stretcher: turns a captured or rolling phrase into a pad or minutes-long drone (x2 to x1024), with freeze, pitch, shift and spread.
gfx-stretch.position_note: end of the lane as an ambient bed; dry passes untouched, wet is seconds late by design

pairs_well_with.why: complementary: grains for short textured holds, stretch for long spectral drones

avoid.why: largest pedal of the suite (58-128 MB of buffers); designed to be used once per rig

gfx-stretch.cpu_note: bench 101 ns mono / 160-179 ns stereo at defaults; coherent mode ≈ 320 ns stereo; size change ×2 while it runs

gfx-grains.name: GoleM FX Grains
gfx-grains.purpose: Granular processor and granular delay: band-limited grain clouds, a loop-free hold of a chord, tempo-synced rhythmic grains, strum and phrase-slice modes.
gfx-grains.position_note: near the end of the lane, before a reverb (it has no built-in reverb)

pairs_well_with.why: no built-in reverb by design: the rack puts gfx-reverb after it
bit-crushing on grains is left to the rack's crusher and filters
complementary hold: short textured time-domain hold vs long spectral stretch

gfx-grains.cpu_note: 74-87 ns at defaults (stereo); 1.13-1.27 µs at 64 pitched grains + glide + feedback, 1.6 µs two layers

gfx-sustainer.name: GoleM FX Sustainer
gfx-sustainer.purpose: Note sustainer and feedback generator: a held note blooms into its own phase-locked harmonic, or is held partial by partial without pumping or hiss.
gfx-sustainer.position_note: before the drive/amp, which gives the squeal its grit; after the amp only with source Key (DI)

pairs_well_with.why: designed to sit before a drive or amp: the amp gives the feedback its grit
Infinite note preset: sustained note then reverb for ambient beds
on bass: held root under a chorus

gfx-sustainer.cpu_note: Feedback 0.21 µs; Sustain 0.47 – 0.51 µs; Both 0.52; chord All 0.84 µs (over budget)

gfx-polysynth.name: GoleM FX Polysynth
gfx-polysynth.purpose: Polyphonic guitar synthesizer from a normal DI, no hex pickup or MIDI: each partial or note becomes a synth tone with filter, envelopes, sub and detune.
gfx-polysynth.position_note: clean DI, first in the lane, before any drive; neck pickup helps the tracked Mono voice

avoid.why: any drive before it: the filterbank needs clean partials
fuzz before it smears partials into intermodulation (chord grumble)
a captured drive pedal before it breaks the clean-partial requirement

gfx-polysynth.cpu_note: 1.49-1.62 µs on pink noise (worst, 7-8% core); strums 1.0-1.08, Mono + detune up to 1.4 µs

gfx-spectralcomp.name: GoleM FX Spectral Comp
gfx-spectralcomp.purpose: Spectral compressor: evens each part of the spectrum downward and guarded-upward without broadband pumping; zero-latency Live or per-bin Studio mode, keyable.
gfx-spectralcomp.position_note: after gate and EQ (or amp/cab), before modulation, delay and reverb; Live mode on stage lanes

pairs_well_with.why: placed after a gate and EQ
vocal de-harsh preset handles harsh edges, the de-esser the sibilants themselves
on a guitar lane, Live after the amp/cab keeps the amp's tone and evens it
sits before modulation, delay and reverb

gfx-spectralcomp.cpu_note: Live (default) 0.55-0.63 µs mono, 1.0 µs stereo; Studio 0.28 µs mono

gfx-morph.name: GoleM FX Morph
gfx-morph.purpose: Zero-latency live vocal mangler: multiband morphing dirt, a physical object (can, bucket, cone...), comp, filter, slap echo, with a feedback guard.
gfx-morph.position_note: Voice: after gate and pitch/formant blocks, before delay/reverb. Guitar: after drive, before amp, or after cab.

pairs_well_with.why: Change the voice first (e.g. growl an octave down), then mangle it here
Pitch/voice change before it; this pedal changes what the voice is put through
Pitch correction goes before it on a voice lane
Chain them: morph for the scream, radio for a recognisable device

avoid.why: Not a substitute: grit stays the multiband dirt for guitar, bass, drums; no vocal guard or de-fizz

gfx-morph.cpu_note: 392 ns raw at defaults on a loaded box (≈240 ns normalised); Three bands 1.03 µs; worst Three 4x Fuzz ×6 1.87 µs

gfx-formant.name: GoleM FX Formant
gfx-formant.purpose: Formant shifter: moves the spectral envelope without changing pitch (bigger/smaller voice, gender/age change, growl, breath, vowel filter on chords).
gfx-formant.position_note: on a voice lane: after the de-esser and any gate, before the octave doubler (gfx-golem)

pairs_well_with.why: goes before gfx-formant on a voice lane so shifted sibilants are already tamed
any gate goes before gfx-formant on a voice lane
placed after gfx-formant when both are used on a voice

gfx-formant.cpu_note: 766 ns mono / 926 ns stereo (Live), to be re-timed; estimate ≈ 3.5 % of a core with breath, more in Grain

gfx-organ.name: GoleM FX Organ
gfx-organ.purpose: Polyphonic tonewheel organ from a guitar or bass DI, no MIDI: each string one organ note with drawbars, percussion, scanner and Rotor.
gfx-organ.position_note: clean DI, first in the lane, before any drive; chords bloom into the registration 100 - 170 ms after the pick

avoid.why: any drive before it: the filterbank needs clean partials
fuzz before it smears partials into intermodulation
its Leslie is inside (speaker Off if a full gfx-rotary panel follows)

gfx-organ.cpu_note: worst case 5.8 % of a core at 48 kHz (88 8888 888, percussion, scanner, Leslie), 7.7 % at 96 kHz, 11.5 % at 192 kHz

rules.text: Choose each block's factory preset by id (<type>/<id>) from descriptors.json; never write or tweak parameter values.
A preset's level_db is already matched to bypass; never add a volume or boost block, or pick a louder preset, to compensate.
Parameters listed in setup_only change latency or are set once at insert: never put them in scenes or on an expression pedal; keep one preset family per song.
On a high-gain lane the intended front is gfx-met (keyed from the lane DI), then gfx-shem (or gfx-emet), then the amp.
gfx-met detects on its key bus fed by the lane's clean DI, so its threshold holds whatever gain follows. A gate after the amp should also key from the DI.
gfx-shem does not clip and can exceed 0 dBFS: it belongs in front of an amp that has gain, never at the end of a lane.
No more than one circuit-simulation pedal (gfx-fuzz, gfx-dist) per lane: each costs about 4-5 µs per sample, a fifth of a core; keep them on mono lanes.
gfx-fuzz models the guitar's pickup from the raw DI: put it first, before any buffer or drive, then the amp.
gfx-golem, gfx-correct, gfx-formant and gfx-morph are voice-first: offer them on voice lanes first; correct also suits guitar, formant and morph other lanes as effects.
Voice lane, golem's order: gate, gfx-deesser, gfx-correct, compression, EQ. gfx-morph comes after the pitch and formant blocks, before delay and reverb.
On a voice lane, gfx-deesser and any gate go before gfx-formant (and before gfx-golem).
For vocal doubles and octaves use gfx-golem; gfx-pitch is the instrument shifter (dives, harmonies, polyphonic capo).
Scream, megaphone, robot or in-a-can voice: gfx-morph. Phone, radio, walkie or electronic megaphone: gfx-radio. gfx-grit is the generic lo-fi crunch.
An amp or amp capture without its own speaker needs gfx-cab right after it, before EQ, modulation and time effects.
When an amp, a cab or an IR follows gfx-bassdi, pick a gfx-bassdi preset with its own speaker emulation off.
gfx-acoustic already models body and microphone: no cab after it (an acoustic amp is fine). It wants a clean DI.
Put gfx-widener after the last mono block (amp, mono cab) and before stereo delay and reverb; a mono block after it folds the width away.
After gfx-widener keep processing linked on L and R (linked limiter or compressor, no per-side amp or saturation) so its exact mono fold survives.
gfx-ducker and gfx-spectralcomp key from the lane's own DI today; keys from another lane or a backing bus wait for golem's key routing.
gfx-vocoder's key-input and talk-box carriers need a key from another lane; until then pick tracked, drone, noise or self-carrier presets.
Modulation such as chorus goes after the amp and cab; before a high-gain stage it turns to mush.
An octave-up octaver goes before a fuzz.
gfx-polysynth, gfx-organ and gfx-sustainer go before any drive or amp: they need the clean partials of the DI.
golem's organ has its own rotating speaker: do not add gfx-rotary after it.
gfx-freqshift is stereo-first: before an amp it turns the rest of the lane stereo; for clang before the amp use gfx-ringmod.
To soften, harden or shorten attacks use gfx-transient (before gfx-comp); to remove attacks (bowed swells, pads) use gfx-swell, before delay and reverb.
Latent modes (gfx-spectralcomp Studio, gfx-mbcomp linear phase, gfx-correct studio) are for non-live lanes; live lanes keep zero-latency presets.
Delay, reverb, shimmer, glitch and IR FX switch through their bypass parameter, so tails ring out across scenes.
One gfx-tuner first in each instrument lane.
gfx-limiter is the end-of-lane safety: last on the route; put it after gfx-mbcomp when that one pushes hard.
gfx-grains and gfx-glitch have no room of their own: put gfx-reverb after them for clouds and pads.
For an old-record sound, gfx-tape's 78 model goes before gfx-radio's gramophone model.
